The '''Produce Level''' was a level in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Here the city's functional facilities, services and heavy industrial structures were located. This level produced the city's food supplies, and [[Dactillion/Legends|dactillions]] and [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]] were trained here to transport residents around the city. Pau City was above this level along with its main spaceport. The Produce level was one of the least populated levels in Pau City.
